description: Government College Dharampuri is a Madhya Pradesh Higher Education Department government college in Dhar district, established in 1989.

supports: The NIRF 2025 College listing contains Govt. College, Dharampuri with city Dharampuri and state Madhya Pradesh.
The Madhya Pradesh Higher Education Department directory identifies Govt College, Dharampuri, college code 2207, district Dhar, and links it to orgid 151.
The official campus homepage names शासकीय महाविद्यालय धरमपुरी जिला धार (म.प्र.) and identifies the Higher Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh.
The official campus heading identifies District Dhar.
The official At A Glance page states establishment year 1989.
The official Programmes Offered page explicitly lists 26 unique regular UG programmes with minimum qualification 10+2; its PG and Diploma sections have no programme rows.
The official Distance Education Programme page explicitly lists 8 PG and 14 UG programmes with minimum qualifications; its Diploma Distance section has no programme rows.

agent_notes: Normal TLS verification for the expected public hostnames failed with the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error; public GETs used curl --insecure only after confirming the requested hostnames.
The official department directory resolves the assigned campus to orgid 151 and college code 2207; the orgid page is the campus's official website.
The official catalogue covers regular and distance education. Regular-course HTML repeats B. A. (Computer - English - Geography); the identical duplicate row was represented once.
No official duration was stated, so duration is null for every course. The official pages explicitly state the listed minimum qualifications.

The career tree has no dedicated Geography course node; M. A. (Geography) uses the nearest-parent Social Sciences & Education mapping at low confidence. English/Hindi label differences and postgraduate-to-available-discipline mappings are marked in the mapping metadata.
